The original preparation placeholders are distinguished from the supplied frozen preview. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the documented normalization and distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains explain the differing source hashes. Repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budget, and policy fingerprints are supplied as Service-bound facts. No candidates or historical candidate outputs were used. I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or create a human attestation.
